attributes.title: 2027 DSDS Annual Session: Medical Emergencies in the Dental Office
attributes.series: Delaware State Dental Society Annual Session
attributes.summary:
The Delaware State Dental Society's 2027 Annual Session is a full-day course on April 30, 2027, at Delaware Park Casino, preceded by the business meeting and president's reception on April 29 at the Hilton Wilmington/Christiana. The topic is managing medical emergencies in the dental office: a morning lecture and afternoon team exercises, with AGD participation credit.

The session carries 6.0 CE credits. Fees before/after April 20 are $335/$385 for DSDS/ADA members, $455/$495 for non-ADA members and $195/$225 for staff; the registration deadline is April 27.
